blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cale88, a banana chip export corporation established in 2021, with Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, Manases Carpio, as a 47.5-percent owner, reported P150 million in sales in 2024 — and yet it did not have a single employee. Senator-Judge Joel Villanueva pointed this out on Monday in his clarificatory questioning of lawyer-accountant Alexander Cabrera, whom the prosecution presented as its forensic financial audit expert who analyzed voluminous bank, tax, and other financial records of the Duterte-Carpio couple.
